patterns: APPSC asks single-term definitions: hundi (letter of credit by shroffs), Banjaras (bulk long-distance traders), share of produce marketed (~15%).
AP-tilt items: Golden Firman of Golconda (1632), Tavernier and the Golconda/Kollur diamond mines, Masulipatnam as Qutb Shahi port.
Book-author matching (Moreland, Habib, Bernier, Foster) and traveller identification (Manucci the Venetian artilleryman/physician, Pelsaert under Jahangir).
Coin terms recur across PSCs: dam = copper, khazana = coins of previous reign; Surat = Bab-ul-Makka.
App MCQs add many match lists on traders, ports and firmans - sound overall but a few firman dates were wrong in the notes.
